live_results.message: Translate this synthetic business message into English. Preserve the order ID, quantity, and prohibition on early shipment: La commande TEST-2042 contient 3 articles. Ne l'expediez pas avant mardi.
live_results.reply:
Translation:
Order TEST-2042 contains 3 items. Do not ship it before Tuesday.

Explanation:
- "La commande TEST-2042" translates to "Order TEST-2042".
- "contient 3 articles" translates to "contains 3 items" (or "contains 3 articles").
- "Ne l'expediez pas avant mardi" translates to "Do not ship it before Tuesday", maintaining the prohibition against early shipment.

Verification note:
The source text is standard French without specific Camfranglais or Cameroon Pidgin terminology. The provided translation is an unverified AI suggestion generated for this prompt and should be manually reviewed before use in official business operations.
live_results.fact_review: TEST-2042, 3 items and the prohibition on shipping before Tuesday were preserved. The answer did not require shipment exactly on Tuesday and explicitly labelled the suggestion as unverified.

live_results.message: Based only on our previous message, what is the order ID, how many items are included, and what is the earliest permitted shipping day? Answer briefly in English.
live_results.reply:
Order ID: TEST-2042
Items included: 3
Earliest permitted shipping day: Tuesday
live_results.fact_review: The follow-up did not repeat the identifier, quantity or day. All three were correctly recovered from the previous complete exchange.

Exactly 24000 history characters accepted and oldest complete pairs removed above the budget
